description: Search the Internet Game Database (IGDB) for video games by title and get back real catalogue records: release date, summary, genres, themes, platforms, game modes, critic and user ratings, developer, publisher and cover art. Optionally restrict to one platform or to games released after a date. AUTHORITATIVE for video-game metadata — the same catalogue Twitch categorises streams against. Example: igdb_search_games({ query: "Breath of the Wild", limit: 5 }).

_apiKey.description: Twitch app credentials as "CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET" (IGDB is gated by Twitch OAuth). Optional — omit to use the shared Pipeworx credential. Get your own at https://dev.twitch.tv/console.

platform_id.description: Restrict to one IGDB platform id — find it with igdb_platforms.

query.description: Game title or part of one, e.g. "Breath of the Wild".

released_after.description: Only games first released after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: igdb_search_games
title: Igdb Search Games
